blocks.goal: Reduce Element's outgoing dependencies by moving selection and query-related implementations (which reference many selector/collector/parser classes) into a new package-private helper class in the same file. Leave public API and signatures in Element unchanged by replacing implementations with small delegators that call the helper. This will remove direct references from Element to selection internals and reduce fan-out.

ops.details: Move the implementation of Element.select(String cssQuery) into ElementQueryHelper.select(Element, String). In Element.select(String) replace the body with: return ElementQueryHelper.select(this, cssQuery); Keep signature and javadoc unchanged.

Move implementation of Element.select(Evaluator evaluator) to ElementQueryHelper.select(Element, Evaluator). Replace Element.select(Evaluator) body with: return ElementQueryHelper.select(this, evaluator); Keep signature unchanged.

Move implementation of Element.selectStream(String) to ElementQueryHelper.selectStream(Element, String). Replace Element.selectStream(String) body with: return ElementQueryHelper.selectStream(this, cssQuery); Keep signature unchanged.

Move implementation of Element.selectStream(Evaluator) to ElementQueryHelper.selectStream(Element, Evaluator). Replace Element.selectStream(Evaluator) body with: return ElementQueryHelper.selectStream(this, evaluator); Keep signature unchanged.

Move implementation of Element.selectFirst(String) to ElementQueryHelper.selectFirst(Element, String). Replace Element.selectFirst(String) body with: return ElementQueryHelper.selectFirst(this, cssQuery); Keep signature unchanged (including @Nullable annotation).

Move implementation of Element.selectFirst(Evaluator) to ElementQueryHelper.selectFirst(Element, Evaluator). Replace Element.selectFirst(Evaluator) body with: return ElementQueryHelper.selectFirst(this, evaluator); Keep signature unchanged (including @Nullable annotation).

Move implementation of Element.selectNodes(String cssQuery) to ElementQueryHelper.selectNodes(Element, String). The helper may call evaluatorOf(cssQuery) and then delegate to Collector.collectNodes. Replace Element.selectNodes(String) body with: return ElementQueryHelper.selectNodes(this, cssQuery); Keep signature unchanged.
